summary: Conditionally resets AI driver random-selection targets. If the incoming index matches the stored primary target at this+0x45FC, the target is cleared, lateral force/torque is recalculated with index 100, and this+0x4420 is zeroed. If the incoming index matches the secondary target at this+0x45F8, that target is cleared. Matches nothing otherwise.

local_names.a2: index value compared against stored random targets

operations.description: Compare a2 against stored primary random target at this+0x45FC
Recalculate lateral force and torque: LateralForceTorqueCalculation(this, 100)
Compare a2 against stored secondary random target at this+0x45F8

unresolved: Meaning of the constant 100 passed to LateralForceTorqueCalculation
Semantic role of the cleared this+0x4420 field beyond being a reset target
